questions.question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown (figures 1 to 3). Find the number on the face opposite to the face having '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d6dfed9792156fe3175804033d95a95f4774a3573c948c9ec635862e822815d.png]
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different cubes, figure 1 and figure 3 ,the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 4 is common on both figure 1 and figure 3, it is clear that 2, 3, 5 and 6 are adjacent to it and remaining number i.e., 1 will be opposite to it.

1 → 4

2 → 5

3 → 6

So, the opposite side of "1" will be side "4".

Hence, the correct answer is "4".

questions.question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements :**

Some bulbs are switches.

No switch is a vase.

All fans are switches.

**Conclusions :**

I. Some bulbs being fans is a possibility.

II. No fan is a vase.

III. All switches are fans.

IV. No bulb is a vase.

options.text: Only Conclusions II and III follow
Only Conclusions I and II follow
Only Conclusions I, II and IV follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f9421f3bd48646226033bceb1dce0ac60781dc6de0ba3d0ce0ada96f6bc7fd5.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some bulbs being fans is a possibility → Follow (As some bulbs are switches and all fans are switches. So, as there is no direct negative or cross relation between bulbs and fans therefore some bulbs can be fans is definitely true)

II. No fan is a vase → Follow (As no switch is a vase and all fans are switches. So, as whole fans comes in switches therefore whole fans too have negative or cross relation with vase therefore it is definitely true)

III. All switches are fans → Does not follow (As all fans are switches. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

IV. No bulb is a vase → Does not follow (As some bulbs are switches and no switch is a vase. So, as there is no direct negative or cross relation between bulbs and fans therefore it is definitely false)

∴ Here, Only conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusions I and II follow".

questions.question: In the following question, four number pairs are given. In each pair the number on left side of (-) is related to the number of the right side of (-) with some Logic/Rule/Relation. Three pairs are similar on basis of same Logic/Rule/Relation. Select the odd one out from the given alternatives. (NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g.13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :

**First number × 10 + 1 = Second number**

__
 
• Option - (1) : 7 - 71

7 × 10 + 1 = 71

 
• Option - (2) : 11 - 111

11 × 10 + 1 = 111

 
• Option - (3) : 8 - 81

8 × 10 + 1 = 81

 
• Option - (4) : 12 - 167

**12 × 10 + 1 = 121 ≠ 167**

Hence, "Option - (4)" is the correct answer.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] Alternate Method__**The logic followed here is : **Inserting (1) at the unit place of 1st number = 2nd number**

S o,

 
• Option - (1) : 7 - 71

​Inserting (1) at the unit place of 7 → 71

71 = 71 (LHS = RHS)

 
• Option - (2) : 11 - 111​

​Inserting (1) at the unit place of 11 → 111

111 = 111 (LHS = RHS)

 
• Option - (3) : 8 - 81​

​Inserting (1) at the unit place of 8 → 81

81 = 81 (LHS = RHS)

 
• Option - (4) : 12 - 167

​Inserting (1) at the unit place of 12 → 121

**121 ≠ 167 (LHS ≠ RHS)**

Hence, **"Option - (4)"** is the correct answer.
